buckets.text: Sierra holds a clear advantage on motivation and pressure. Sierra is playing at home in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and the crowd should help with the big points. Offsetting that, both have lost ground over 90 days (-51 for Kasintseva, -74 for Sierra), though Kasintseva has lost less.
